description: Undo a brand_truth_delete: clears the entry's deletedAt (making it live again — it reappears in default brand_truth_list/brand_truth_get results and resumes grounding generation) and clears the rejection memory that delete recorded, so the fact is no longer suppressed from future extractions.

id.description: Brand truth entry ID to restore (find trashed entries with brand_truth_list(includeDeleted: true)).

name: brand_truth_restore
